Define measures such as task success, perception accuracy, cycle time, trajectory quality, repeatability, and reliability. · Collaborate with robotics, perception, ML, controls, manufacturing, and plant-facing teams to troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and transition prototypes from simulation through hardware integration, validation, and deployment. · Provide technical ownership of robotic applications from early prototyping and simulation through hardware integration, validation, and deployment. · Optional: Integrate robotic cells with industrial systems and safety infrastructure, including PLCs (OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, Modbus), safety I/O, and robot safety configurations in accordance with ISO 10218 and ISO/TS 15066. Preferred qualifications · 5+ years of experience in robotics software, industrial robotics, AI-enabled robotics, manipulation, or automation systems. · Experience with FANUC, Universal Robots, collaborative or industrial manipulators, grippers, wrist-mounted cameras, depth sensors, industrial automation, material handling, robotic pick-and-place, machine tending, factory simulation, virtual commissioning, or plant-floor robotic applications. · Experience with MoveIt/MoveIt Task Constructor, Lula, RMPflow, OMPL, NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, Omniverse Replicator, or similar frameworks. · Experience with VLA models, multimodal robotics, imitation learning, learned manipulation policies, synthetic data, domain randomization, automated annotation, simulation-to-real transfer, or simulated-environment training. · Experience with 3D perception, including RGB-D, point clouds, 6D pose estimation, registration, and geometric computer vision. · Experience deploying AI models with PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or comparable GPU-accelerated inference frameworks. · Experience optimizing control-loop timing, perception and inference latency, trajectory execution, and end-to-end task cycle time. · Experience taking robotic systems from research or prototype environments through integration, validation, and deployment in production or manufacturing settings.

This role sits at the intersection of workflow management, team coordination, people operations, and process improvement. You will help maintain visibility into work across multiple client portfolios, monitor deadlines and commitments, identify operational bottlenecks, and coordinate follow-through on outstanding actions. You will also support employee onboarding, performance management processes, learning and development activities, and other people-related initiatives. This is not simply a task-tracking or administrative support role. We are looking for someone who can recognize when something is not working, ask the right questions, coordinate the appropriate response, and follow through until the issue is resolved. You will work closely with Client Leads and leadership to ensure the team has the structure, information, and support needed to deliver consistently. Key Responsibilities Workflow Management & Client Delivery Coordination Monitor workflows, deadlines, and deliverables across multiple client portfolios. Coordinate daily workflow and communication triage to ensure incoming requests are appropriately assigned and acknowledged. Track outstanding commitments and follow up with responsible team members to support timely completion. Identify overdue tasks, stalled workflows, competing priorities, and potential delivery risks. Work with Client Leads to understand operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions. Maintain visibility into upcoming deadlines and ensure potential issues are escalated early. Support consistent use of workflow management systems and established operating procedures. Operational Reporting & Performance Visibility Prepare weekly operational reports highlighting workflow exceptions, delivery risks, team capacity concerns, and outstanding actions. Identify recurring patterns in missed deadlines, delayed responses, or incomplete workflows. Track operational performance indicators and support improvements in team productivity and service delivery. Provide leadership with concise, actionable updates rather than simply reporting completed activities. Maintain action trackers and follow through on agreed improvement initiatives. People Operations & Employee Development Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including documentation, schedules, and collaboration with IT and relevant team members. Maintain employee records, onboarding checklists, and people operations trackers. Coordinate performance review schedules, probation evaluations, and development plan follow-ups. Support the planning and administration of internal learning and development activities. Monitor completion of assigned training and development actions. Help ensure people-related processes are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Identify inefficiencies, recurring workflow issues, and opportunities to simplify internal processes. Document and maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, and internal process guidelines. Recommend practical improvements to team coordination, task management, and operational reporting. Support the implementation of approved process changes and monitor their effectiveness. Collaborate with team members to improve the consistency and reliability of internal operations. Communication & Cross-Functional Coordination Serve as a coordination point between Client Leads, team members, and leadership on operational matters. Communicate clearly and professionally regarding deadlines, outstanding actions, and operational priorities.
